alt: Our diagram of three ways to get ammo in GTA 6: buy ammo or an Ammo Pack at gun stores, switch between Jason and Lucia for separate ammo, or swap to a stored gun in your car trunk. Not a game screenshot.

data.title: Ways to get ammo

cards.title: Gun stores
cards.body: Buy ammo or a $950 Ammo Pack at shops like Big Shots (Dexerto).

cards.title: Switch character
cards.body: Jason and Lucia each hold their own ammo (Inven Global).

cards.title: Car trunk
cards.body: Open your trunk to swap to another owned gun (GamesRadar+).
